description: This file defines the HttpContext class, which wraps a Vert.x RoutingContext and implements an ExecutionContext interface. It provides methods for storing and retrieving request-specific data and tracing information within a HTTP request handling context.

classes.name: HttpContext
classes.description: Represents the context for handling a Vert.x HTTP request, wrapping the RoutingContext and managing tracing information.

methods.name: HttpContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes HttpContext with a given RoutingContext, throws NullPointerException if null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from RoutingContext by key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the RoutingContext.

methods.name: getTracingContext
methods.description: Returns the current SpanContext for tracing.
